Both traces tackle the logic puzzle by systematically testing the possible positions of the "Maple-1716-Elm-Cloth" chain. Trace 1 indexes the cases by the slot of the 1716 record (m), while Trace 2 indexes by the starting slot of the chain. Both explore the invalid positions (m=2, m=4, m=5 in Trace 1; start=1, start=3 in Trace 2) and find contradictions with other blocks, pruning them. Both arrive at the correct solution when the chain starts at slot 2 (m=3). After finding the solution, both traces engage in multiple redundant re-verifications of the constraints, re-executing steps without adding new information.

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Case 1: $m=2$. $Y_2 = 1716$." end="Thus $m=2$ seems impossible." basis=The solver opens a branch exploring the placement of 1716 in slot 2, explores subcases for Leather/Palm, and explicitly eliminates the branch due to conflicts.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Are there other subcases for Case 2?" end="Conflict. So $m=4$ fails." basis=The solver explores placing 1716 in slot 4, tests constraints, and explicitly eliminates the branch due to a conflict.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="What about $m=5$? $Y_5=1716$." end="Impossible. So $m \neq 5$." basis=The solver explores placing 1716 in slot 5 and immediately eliminates it because it would require a slot 7.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's verify again. 1. 1714 record" end="Yes, immediate left. All constraints satisfied?" basis=The solver re-executes a check of all 12 constraints against the found solution, adding no new information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's double check. Slot 1: Label=Birch" end="Slot 3 has Label Ash. This fits." basis=The solver re-verifies the distinctness of attributes and re-checks the Palm/Ash constraint, adding no new information.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="One check on \"Palm record\"." end="Label Ash. This fits." basis=The solver re-verifies the interpretation of the Palm/Ash constraint and confirms the same fit again.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Case A: Maple chain starts at Slot 1." end="So Case A is impossible." basis=The solver opens a branch placing the Maple chain at slot 1, explores subcases for Palm/Ash and Leather, and explicitly eliminates the branch.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's quickly check if Case C (Maple chain starts at 3) could work." end="So Case C is impossible." basis=The solver opens a branch placing the Maple chain at slot 3, explores subcases, and explicitly eliminates the branch.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's quickly check if there is any ambiguity in the deduction." end="The logic holds up." basis=The solver re-walks the entire derivation and uniqueness of the solution, adding no new constraints.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's do a final sanity check." end="Yes. Everything is consistent." basis=The solver re-executes a check of all 12 constraints against the found solution.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let's double check the bindings and labels again." end="Slot 6. Yes). Everything holds." basis=The solver re-verifies the distinctness of all attributes and re-checks constraints 8, 5, and 11.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=probable start="One detail: \"The 1716 record stands immediately left of the Elm record.\"" end="This is consistent. Just to" basis=The solver re-verifies the interpretation of the "immediately left" constraint, adding no new information.
